researched.notes: Horizontal productivity software; the candidate URL was the /edu landing page. Corporate history is tangled: their own About timeline starts '2009: Grammarly is founded', and the company later acquired Superhuman and Coda and rebranded the whole suite as Superhuman - so 2009 is the entity's origin, not the Superhuman product's. Claims 40M+ daily users and 3,000+ academic institutions. HQ not published on the site.

researched.description: Backup, disaster recovery, and ransomware resilience software for hybrid cloud data across all industries
researched.notes: Horizontal data protection - their own solutions menu lists government and education alongside financial services, healthcare, enterprise, service providers, and small business. Neither their About nor Contact page states an HQ or founding year, so both are omitted.
